ALPHA 50 UNITES TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING, MANUFACTURING, AND DEPLOYMENT, IN ONE FULL-SCOPE 50 MW PLANT.

With its compact footprint and designed for outdoor installation, ALPHA 50 can be easily configured into larger plants. Fully skid-mounted, pre-fabricated and standardised, offering in-built redundancy for key components to maximise uptime, the full-scope plant can cope with the widest ambient temperature range and is capable of being deployed globally into any territory.
